'''Gordul Koga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thug that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Koga worked as an enforcer for the criminal [[Farious Gletch]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Koga decided go into business for himself. But Gletch was displeased with Koga's decision and paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to hunt the Aqualish down and kill him.
